Dr. Andrew Jones is a natural pet health advocate, author, and former practicing veterinarian who enjoys making free educational and instructional videos for pet lovers and pet parents.  

Dr. Jones' natural pet health YouTube channel,  Veterinary Secrets, shares short educational and instructional 'How To" videos on common pet health concerns, new discoveries and updates in conventional and holistic veterinary medicine, as well as tips, techniques and home remedies to help your dog and cat. New videos are uploaded on Tuesdays and Fridays.

If you like my videos, then I encourage you to subscribe to my channel and share my videos! 

If you have ideas or topics in mind, please feel free to comment and share those ideas. I will try to respond or make a video about it.
